# BGP Session Reset Procedure — FigDown Figure

I don't have direct access to `reference/experimental/flowchart.md` in this session, so I'm composing the flowchart from the vocabulary the task itself names — `process`, `decision`, `terminator` — combined with the genre-independent skeleton rules (quoted labels, `->` edges, `figdown 0.2` — wait, flowchart's floor is `0.1`, so I stay there). If the genre file specifies different keyword spellings, treat this as a first draft to reconcile against it before shipping.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to human operator"

checkcounters -> errorsfound
errorsfound -> clearcounters "yes"
errorsfound -> escalate "no"
clearcounters -> monitor
```

Notes for the record:

- Node ids and roles follow exactly what was specified: `checkcounters` and `clearcounters` are `process` steps, `errorsfound` is the `decision`, and `monitor` / `escalate` are `terminator`s ending the flow.
- The two branches out of `errorsfound` carry the `"yes"` / `"no"` edge labels per the described logic; all other edges are unlabeled sequence steps.
- Before rendering, run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js` on this file — if `process`/`decision`/`terminator`/edge-label spellings differ from what `reference/experimental/flowchart.md` actually defines, the build will surface it as a line error naming the correct keyword, and the fix is mechanical.
